spec.description:
EcoSeal 201 Cloth Tape is a heavy-duty, high-tack
polyethylene-coated cloth tape specially designed for bonding, sealing, and
mending overlapped edges of ClimaWrap, vapour barriers, and building membranes.
Formulated with a high-tack pressure-sensitive acrylic/synthetic adhesive, it
provides outstanding adhesion, shear strength, and weather resistance across
Australian climatic conditions. It seals overlaps, joins, and penetrations to
maintain airtight and watertight building envelope integrity.
features:
Specially designed for bonding, sealing, and mending building membranes and
ClimaWrap
High-tack adhesive provides outstanding adhesion and cohesion
Polyethylene-coated cloth backing resists tears, punctures, and abrasion
Forms a durable, moisture-resistant and airtight seal

Conforms easily to
irregular surfaces, corners, and penetrations

Hand tearable for fast,
convenient installation on site

Reliable bonding across wide temperature
variations in Australia

technical.value:
Polyethylene-coated cloth backing with
high-tack adhesive
48 mm width x 50 m length (2.4 m²)

Bonding, sealing, and mending overlapped edges of
building wraps

spec.fire:
Complies with early fire hazard requirements when used in conjunction with
compliant building membranes
spec.sustainability: Low VOC, durable long-life adhesive system
install:
Ensure building wrap surfaces are clean, dry, and free of dust,
grease, and moisture

Align membrane lap with recommended overlap
(minimum 150mm or 50mm if taped per AS 4200.2)

Centre EcoSeal 201 Cloth Tape
evenly over the joint seam

Press tape firmly along the entire length using
hand pressure or a squeegee to ensure 100% surface contact

Smooth out any air
bubbles or wrinkles

Tape around window flashings, penetrations, and frame
junctions to ensure airtightness
selection_checklist:
Confirm tape is
being paired with ClimaWrap, vapour barriers, or building membranes

Measure
total linear metres of horizontal and vertical membrane overlaps and
penetrations

Ensure surface temperature during installation allows proper
adhesive bonding
limitations:
Surfaces must be dry and clean
before application

Pressure-sensitive adhesive requires firm pressure to
achieve full bonding
Not designed for structural mechanical fastening

retrieval.rag_summary:
Ecowool EcoSeal Tape (EcoSeal 201 Cloth Tape) is a
heavy-duty 48mm x 50m polyethylene-coated cloth tape distributed by PGF
Insulation. Engineered with an aggressive, high-tack pressure-sensitive
adhesive, it bonds, seals, and mends overlapped edges of ClimaWrap wall wraps,
vapour barriers, and pliable building membranes. Hand-tearable for fast on-site
application, it provides a weather-tight, moisture-resistant barrier that
prevents air leakage and wind-driven rain penetration across the building
envelope.
